description.zh: Skill 类目Code，如果传入多个，使用英文逗号隔开。如果是二级类目，使用 一级类目.二级类目的方式传入
description.en: The skill category code. Separate multiple codes with commas. For a second-level category, use the format: first-level category.second-level category.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页的最大条目数。最大值为 100。默认值为 20。
description.en: The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.

description.zh: 下一个查询开始 Token，取值为上一次 API 调用返回的 NextToken 参数值
description.en: The token for the next query. Set this to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call.
The number of entries to skip for pagination.
